answer: Forging 396 of these means fabricating 396 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The ember is the wall and the zephyr is the gate: Proof comes from goldsmith hallmark registration: a registration the assay office renews after hallmarked pieces. A farm of 396 aliases must climb the wall 396 times, the voyage ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
